parameters.query:
with d as (
  insert into drafts (enquiry_id, version, subject, body, reasoning, tools_used, confidence, grounding_check,
                      proposed_slot, model, needs_review, review_reason, customer_id)
  select $1::uuid, coalesce((select max(version) from drafts where enquiry_id = $1::uuid), 0) + 1,
         nullif($2, ''), $3, nullif($4, ''), $5::jsonb, nullif($6, ''), $7::jsonb, nullif($8, '')::jsonb, $9,
         $10::boolean, nullif($11, ''), nullif($12, '')
   where $13::boolean
  returning id
), e as (
  update enquiries set status = $14, customer_id = coalesce(nullif($12, ''), customer_id) where id = $1::uuid returning id
), a as (
  insert into audit_log (enquiry_id, workflow_execution_id, step, event, detail, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, duration_ms)
  values ($1::uuid, $15, 'draft', $16, $17::jsonb, $9, $18::int, $19::int, nullif($20, '')::numeric, $21::int)
)
select (select id from d) as draft_id;
